lines.text: A big Atomy P V number is not a big bank balance.
P V means Point Value. Atomy's U S agreement defines it as a measurement used in the compensation plan.
It is not a dollar balance you can withdraw. Commissions still depend on the plan and your eligibility.
So read the label before reading the number. Save this: points measure volume; they do not promise income.
